components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action button with micro-lift hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #f4f4f4; padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms ease, background 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #000000; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tactile bordered button for secondary discovery actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms ease, background 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #111111; color: #f4f4f4; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 44x44px circular theme switcher with accessible hit area.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle night mode"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(17,17,17,0.12); background: #ffffff; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: A high-craft, editorial design system built for a modern web engineering practice. It balances the warm, tangible authority of an artisan workshop with the razor-sharp execution of production software. The atmosphere is quiet, confident, and grounded: tactile eggshell paper, deep ink typography, subtle physical grain, and zero decorative fluff.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile warmth: Parchment canvas texture paired with high-contrast ink typography.
Asymmetric editorial rhythm: Alternating between full-width statements, two-column editorial splits, and structured pricing comparison grids.
Zero-bullshit clarity: Direct, plain-language hierarchy with zero placeholder buzzwords.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: High-saturation color appears exclusively on functional status signals. The interface speaks in typography and tonal contrast.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight without redundant category tags or tiny uppercase eyebrows above them.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from material contrast and precise borders, never from heavy drop shadows or colored glowing halos.

dos: Do maintain a strict 65–75ch character measure for all long-form body paragraphs.
Do preserve the tactile eggshell texture and warm parchment tones in light mode.
Do show real project screens with authentic operational details instead of generic placeholder art.
Do ensure every interactive element meets the 44×44px mobile touch target minimum.
donts: Don't reintroduce uppercase kicker tags or eyebrow labels above section headings.
Don't use decorative gradient text or colored shadow halos.
Don't stack consecutive 3-card icon grids without varying the layout rhythm.
Don't use generic buzzwords ('streamline', 'seamless', 'synergy') in project descriptions.
